theorems.name: Submission.bv_ext_euclideanDivergence_smul
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n) (x : Rn n), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x → Chapter02.euclideanDivergence (fun y ↦ φ y • g y) x = φ x * Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x + fderiv ℝ φ x (g x)
